text:
maria: Heads-up: mkdocs linkcheck failing for /guides/deploy due to stray trailing space in heading anchors. Build error below. Anyone seen this?

kevin: yep. saw this in a few locales. mkdocs slugify/anchor behavior strips trailing spaces inconsistently. Quick fix is to normalize heading ids or add explicit ids.

maria: linkcheck output: 'fragment not found: /guides/deploy#queue-management ' (note trailing space at the end of the fragment)

ci-bot: build #4821 failed in docs-ci (mkdocs-linkcheck) :x: logs: https://ci.redwood/logs/4821/linkcheck.log

kevin: suggest a quick grep to find offenders: `grep -nE '^#+ .* $' -R docs/ | sed -n '1,50p'` — lists headings ending with a space.

maria: can we automate a fix in CI? thinking pre-commit or docs-ci step to trim trailing whitespace in headings and then re-run linkcheck.

devex-ryan: agreed. also add a regression test: run the fragment resolver across built site and fail if any anchor has leading/trailing whitespace. i'll add a tiny test in docs/test/anchor_spec.js

kevin: temp patch i used locally: `git apply <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: docs/guides/deploy.md
@@
-### Queue management 
+### Queue management
*** End Patch
PATCH`

kevin: that fixed the local linkcheck for me.

maria: :thumbsup: i'll apply the same cleanup to the localized copies (fr/es/de) — those are the usual culprits. also noticed some table headers ending with a colon which changes slug output, will tidy those too.

docs-bot: reminder: when editing localized files prefer the original as source. run `yarn docs:sync --locales` after changes to propagate anchors safely.

maria: pushing a cleanup PR in a minute. will include the grep, the patch, and the small test. will also add a one-liner in the styleguide.

ci-bot: build #4822 queued (docs-cleanup) :hourglass_flowing_sand:

kevin: if trimming creates duplicate anchors we should prefer explicit header ids as fallback, e.g. `### Queue management {#queue-management}`. that avoids auto-slug ambiguity.

devex-ryan: i'll add that as a style rule in docs/style.md: "use explicit IDs for headings where truncation or punctuation may collide". can someone add a short example in the PR?

maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1987 — contains trim + style note + anchor regression test. please review @kevin @devex-ryan

kevin: reviewing now. small nit: prefer `<!-- id: queue-management -->` inline comment for some MDX flows, but not blocking.

maria: merging after CI passes.

ci-bot: build #4823 passed. docs linkcheck fixed :tada:
